summary: A large collection of Jupyter notebook tutorials that teach you to build AI agents, from simple chatbots to multi-agent systems.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: GenAI Agents is a library of hands-on notebooks showing how to build generative AI agents. It starts with core patterns and beginner agents, includes a LangGraph framework tutorial, and goes on to educational, business, creative, analysis, news, shopping, productivity and testing agents. Most notebooks use LangChain and LangGraph, and the README notes they were updated in 2026 to work with LangChain 1.x and LangGraph 1.x.
sixtySeconds.problem: Agent tutorials are scattered and quickly go out of date. This repo gathers many working examples by category so you can learn by running them.
whoFor: Developers learning to build AI agents
Teams looking for agent patterns to copy
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Use it for a broad, categorized set of runnable agent examples, especially with LangGraph.
requirements: API keys for the model providers each notebook uses

overview: Clone the repo and install the shared dependencies with pip install -r requirements.txt.
Go to the folder of the technique you want under all_agents_tutorials and open its notebook.
Each notebook installs anything extra in its first cell. The license is a custom non-commercial license; commercial use needs written permission.
